results.title: SUNMI Deepens Eurasia Partnership at the Belt and Road Summit
results.description: HONG KONG, Sept. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SUNMI Technology (06810.HK) announced on September 10, separate cooperation agreements with Türkiye-based fintech company TOKEN and Mongolia-based digital bank M bank at the 11th Belt and Road Summit in Hong Kong.
